description: This Java source file defines the SearchActor class, an Akka actor responsible for handling various ThingSearchCommand operations such as count and query. It manages parsing commands, executing searches via persistence, and streaming results, specifically within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: SearchActor
classes.description: An Akka actor for handling Thing search commands such as count, query, and streaming of results. It manages command parsing, interacts with persistence layer, and streams search results back to callers.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating SearchActor with provided query parser and persistence dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for the actor — mapping message types to handler methods.

methods.name: namespaceReport
methods.description: Handles generation of namespace count report in response to SudoRetrieveNamespaceReport commands.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Initiates count operation based on CountThings command, parsing the query and querying the persistence layer.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Handles sudo-based count commands, similar to count but with elevated privileges.

methods.name: executeCount
methods.description: Performs the actual count operation after parsing commands and measuring timing, handling both sudo and non-sudo scenarios.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Handles streaming search results for StreamThings commands, managing cursors, query execution, and result streaming.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles general query commands, parsing, executing search, and returning result pages.

methods.name: getSystem
methods.description: Returns the ActorSystem associated with the actor context.

methods.name: stopTimerAndHandleError
methods.description: Utility method to stop timers and handle errors during stream processing.

methods.name: processSearchPersistenceResult
methods.description: Adds logging to the source of search results and ensures proper handling of persistence results.

methods.name: asDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts generic Throwables into DittoRuntimeExceptions, adding headers and logging as needed.

methods.name: toQueryThingsResponse
methods.description: Transforms search result IDs into a SearchResult response, including optional cursor and result processing.

methods.name: startNewTimer
methods.description: Creates and starts a new timer metric, tagged with query type and API version.

methods.name: createQuerySource
methods.description: Creates a source stream for a query, parsing input commands or providing a failed source if parsing fails.

methods.name: stopTimer
methods.description: Stops a previously started timer, ignoring errors if stopped already.
